ai_proposals_reviewed.name: ai_proposals_reviewed
ai_proposals_reviewed.value: ("ai_proposals"."status" = 'pending') = ("ai_proposals"."reviewed_by" is null) and ("ai_proposals"."reviewed_by" is null) = ("ai_proposals"."reviewed_at" is null)

notifications_one_subject.name: notifications_one_subject
notifications_one_subject.value:
("notifications"."kind" = 'deadline' and "notifications"."deadline_id" is not null and "notifications"."document_id" is null)
        or ("notifications"."kind" <> 'deadline' and "notifications"."document_id" is not null and "notifications"."deadline_id" is null)

budgets_approved.name: budgets_approved
budgets_approved.value: "budgets"."status" = 'draft' or ("budgets"."approved_by" is not null and "budgets"."approved_at" is not null)

imports_payroll.name: imports_payroll
imports_payroll.value: "imports"."kind" <> 'payroll' or ("imports"."file_id" is null and "imports"."grant_id" is null and "imports"."sensitivity" = 'payroll')

imports_confirmed.name: imports_confirmed
imports_confirmed.value: "imports"."status" <> 'confirmed' or ("imports"."confirmed_by" is not null and "imports"."confirmed_at" is not null)

payroll_runs_posted.name: payroll_runs_posted
payroll_runs_posted.value: "payroll_runs"."status" = 'draft' or ("payroll_runs"."posted_by" is not null and "payroll_runs"."posted_at" is not null)

payroll_runs_voided.name: payroll_runs_voided
payroll_runs_voided.value: "payroll_runs"."status" <> 'voided' or ("payroll_runs"."voided_by" is not null and "payroll_runs"."voided_at" is not null)

receipts_confirmed.name: receipts_confirmed
receipts_confirmed.value: "receipts"."status" = 'draft' or ("receipts"."total_cents" is not null and "receipts"."confirmed_by" is not null and "receipts"."confirmed_at" is not null)

receipts_voided.name: receipts_voided
receipts_voided.value: "receipts"."status" <> 'voided' or ("receipts"."voided_by" is not null and "receipts"."voided_at" is not null)

warnings_reviewed.name: warnings_reviewed
warnings_reviewed.value: "warnings"."status" = 'open' or ("warnings"."reviewed_by" is not null and "warnings"."reviewed_at" is not null)
